events.headline: Trump rejects Iran's conditional proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, tells aides he expects to resume bombing Iran after the November midterms; indirect US-Iran talks continue via Qatari mediators
Oil prices hold broadly flat (Brent ~$105.24, WTI ~$92.54) on Sept 29 as markets weigh persistent Strait of Hormuz supply risk against hopes for ceasefire progress in Qatari-mediated talks

Broad chip selloff deepens: Arm Holdings sinks 9% (no company-specific news; SoftBank's $25B margin loan against ARM shares adds a market-linked pressure point), Qualcomm -6%, Marvell -5%, Intel and AMD also down sharply
Fed hiked rates to 3.75%-4.00% in September (first hike in 3+ years) on persistently elevated inflation; 16 of 18 officials see at least one more hike this year

China's suspension of its October 2025 rare-earth, lithium-battery and critical-materials export controls (paused through Nov 10, 2026) continues to ease supply-chain disruption risk for downstream manufacturers
